description: Conditional historical annual residual; not available-water or dry-period budget.

eea/PT12057937.name: Atouguia da Baleia
assumptions: Reported water+ production is deducted as if it were a separate, fully used share of treated output. Production is not proof of consumption; internal recirculation could overlap this balance.
All remaining treated output is hypothetically accessible before further environmental or contractual deductions. This is a technical scenario, not evidence of unused or permitted supply.
Uniform annual-average supply and plant operation; no seasonal or peak-day assurance. Existing demand model already includes purification recovery; it must not be deducted twice.
missing: Water quality, treatment and delivery access
